title: Lag-1 continuous sum-state kernel for next-draw sum distribution
hypothesis: The previous draw's total sum may contain incremental one-step information about the next draw's total-sum distribution beyond the exact 5-of-40 combinatorial null. This is a single lag-1 state test, distinct from PSR-10 (previous sum conditioning next position marginals) and Q98 (previous full geometry conditioning next position marginals).
target: Next draw total sum, support 15..190 inclusive (176 categories).

exact_null.distribution: p0(s) = number of 5-subsets of {1,...,40} summing to s divided by C(40,5)
exact_null.construction: integer dynamic programming over k=0..5 and sums 0..190; no normal approximation

model.state: previous draw total sum, standardized by exact-null mean and standard deviation
model.tie_break: smallest h if Validation Brier scores tie

chronology.cutoff_rule: for target index t, only transitions i -> i+1 with i+1 < t are eligible; current state is S_(t-1)

selection: Select exactly one bandwidth on Validation by minimum mean multiclass Brier score. No parameter or endpoint selection on Blind OOS.

endpoints.primary: multiclass Brier gain versus exact-null PMF; gain = Brier_exact - Brier_model, positive is better
endpoints.secondary: log-loss gain versus exact-null PMF; gain = logloss_exact - logloss_model, positive is better

inference.bootstrap: circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, 10000 replicates, percentile 95% CI
inference.randomization: block sign-flip test, contiguous blocks of 20 (last block shorter), 50000 replicates, one-sided alternative gain > 0
inference.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across all 4 bandwidths x 2 endpoints (8 tests) on historical Blind OOS
inference.seed: fixed deterministic xorshift32 seed per endpoint

integrity_checks: archive dates unique and strictly increasing
each draw is five unique sorted integers in [1,40]
exact null sums to one and counts exactly 658008 five-subsets
every transition outcome index used for target t is strictly less than t
all forecast probability vectors sum to one within 1e-12
changing target/future outcomes cannot alter that target's forecast
deterministic full replay must match persisted report and ledger
guardrails: Historical Blind OOS is exposed to prior SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
This experiment predicts only the sum marginal, not a coherent quintet distribution.
No freeze, active engine, Q60 ledger, or production artifact may be modified.
No merge or promotion; human review required.
next_action: Run the frozen protocol once; if no positive evidence, close this specific lag-1 sum-state line and continue Q60 append-only prospective collection.
